_comment: Canonical CLISession document shape. client is the authority - it creates and stores this document when a CLI/BYO client authenticates via mTLS. CLI sessions are strictly disjoint from operator sessions - they represent the routing namespace for BYO/CLI clients to receive SSE events. A field mismatch breaks CLI session routing and event delivery.

cli_session._description: Authenticated CLI/BYO session. Created when a CLI client successfully authenticates with the client via mTLS. Strictly disjoint from operator_session_id namespace.

id.description: Session identifier (UUID v4). Primary key. Never conflated with operator_session_id.

session_type.description: Session type discriminator. See status.json session.type.

user_id.description: User ID who owns this CLI session.

operator_session_id.description: Operator session ID that created this CLI session. Binds the CLI session to a specific Operator for authorization.

is_active.description: Whether the session is currently active.

absolute_expires_at.description: Absolute expiry timestamp. Session is invalid after this time regardless of activity.

idle_expires_at.description: Idle expiry timestamp. Session is invalid if no activity occurs before this time.

system_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the client system. Used for identification.

cert_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the mTLS client certificate.

cert_serial.description: Serial number of the mTLS client certificate. Used for revocation checking.

login_method.description: Authentication method used to create this session. See status.json auth.login_method.
